description: For concrete pour, this completion sign-off form records pre-pour inspection, batch sequence, placement rate, consolidation, testing, joints, finishing, curing, and protection. Its supporting evidence includes delivery tickets, slump, air and temperature tests, cylinder log, placement photos, and curing observations.

blocks.guidance: Link this concrete pour record to its evidence.

blocks.guidance: Capture placement area, mix design, volume, reinforcement, embeds, forms, access, pump plan, weather, and finish class for this concrete pour.
blocks.label: Concrete Pour Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify placement area, mix design, volume, reinforcement, embeds, forms, access, pump plan, weather, and finish class for this concrete pour record.

blocks.guidance: Explain each unnecessary concrete pour evidence item.
items: Source, date, author, and version can be identified
Measurements include units and test conditions
Photos or attachments identify their location and purpose
Unknown or inaccessible conditions are conspicuous

blocks.guidance: Hold placement for failed pre-pour review, wrong mix, unsafe access, severe weather, or out-of-limit test result. Do not release affected concrete pour work.

subtitle: Concrete Pour Completion Sign-Off Form: concrete placement readiness and quality record using placement area, pre-pour inspection, and delivery tickets.
title: Concrete Pour Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during concrete placement readiness and quality record when the concrete pour record must identify placement area, mix design, volume, reinforcement, embeds, forms, access, pump plan, weather, and finish class. Complete the applicable handoff for placed quantity, test sample custody, curing release, deficiency follow-up, finish acceptance, and record archive.
